scope: Deterministic theory/operator implementation audit only. No observational data, no likelihood, no nonlinear matter-power claim, no parameter fit, and no post-result retuning.

frozen_theory_inputs.note: The common dimensional prefactor 2(2-KB)/a0 is factored out of the numerical box audit because the box is dimensionless. No physical amplitude is inferred from NL1A.

numerics.dealiasing: 2/3 rule applied to nonlinear flux before divergence
numerics.spectral_convergence_comparison: low Fourier modes m=0..32 of N=512 against N=1024
numerics.single_mode_test: chi=cos(3x); even/non-3-odd harmonics below mode 40 are forbidden up to numerical leakage

classification_rule.pass: NL1A_PSEUDOSPECTRAL_OPERATOR_BRIDGE_PASS if and only if every primary gate passes.

interpretation_rule.if_pass: The exact NL0C leading Y-sector operator is implemented reproducibly in the pseudospectral infrastructure, including its variational sign, degree-two homogeneity, beta0 scaling, translation/axis invariance, and resolution control. This is not yet a physical nonlinear-growth prediction.
interpretation_rule.if_fail: Do not run a nonlinear-growth calculation. Repair only implementation errors without changing the preregistered theory inputs or gates, or preserve the failure if the discrepancy is scientific/numerical rather than technical.

next_step_if_pass: NL1B must freeze the actual second-order dynamical closure from the covariant AeST+memory equations before any claim that memory changes nonlinear structure growth. A toy GR/Poisson closure must not be substituted and labelled AeST+memory.
